items.title: China's Moonshot AI Hits $35B Valuation in Just 7 Months
items.summary:
Moonshot AI closed a $3.5B round at a $35B valuation, up from $4.8B in January—a 7x jump in 7 months, driven by its Kimi K3 model (2.8 trillion parameters, the largest open-weight model globally).

In this episode of Front Page, we break down the funding trajectory, state-backed investment ties, GPU demand overwhelming signups, the undisclosed 51% hallucination rate, China's data access laws, and an unaddressed April data breach—raising the question of whether this valuation reflects real technical achievement or geopolitical AI race dynamics.

items.title: Cognizant Grows 4.5% on AI Deals - Yet Bookings Collapse 6%, Here's Why!
items.summary:
Cognizant posted $5.48B in Q2 revenue (up 4.5% YoY), but constant-currency growth slowed to 4.1% from 7.2% last year, a warning sign that enterprise AI momentum is normalising.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down quarterly bookings drop 6%, financial services leading growth at 12%, regional slowdowns in Europe and rest of world, operating margins at 15.9%, M&A activity (Astria acquisition), shareholder returns ($1.15B buyback), and Cognizant's pivot from AI experimentation to enterprise execution—is this a durable transition or early profit-taking?

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Pocket FM's Head of AI on Its $400M Storytelling Bet
items.summary:
Pocket FM cut its per-hour production cost from nearly $1,000 to $50-60 in a year, a shift that helped push annualised revenue past $400 million, up from $198 million 12 months earlier. 

In this episode of Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Vasu Sharma, Head of AI at Pocket FM and a former Meta FAIR researcher, to break down why the company is building its own proprietary storytelling models instead of relying on off-the-shelf tools from 11 Labs and OpenAI, how AI-driven adaptation lets creators localise stories across geographies without rewriting from scratch, why generic AI models are too neutral for dramatic writing, the economics behind Pocket FM's pay-per-episode model, and how the platform is scaling India's creator economy toward $400 crore in creator earnings this year.
